findings.summary: __attrs_post_init__ pushes a scope even when id_of(schema) returns None (no $id or boolean schema), putting None on the resolver scope stack, which can break or misdirect urljoin in resolve/resolving; needs a None guard.

judge.reason: Identifies unconditional scope push of None id needing a None guard, same as b1.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The scope stack grows on every descend/evolve because pushed scopes are never popped (only _validate_reference pops), leaving stale base URIs so refs in sibling subschemas may resolve against the wrong base.

judge.reason: Scope stack growth claim is a different, speculative complaint; not the None-scope defect.

findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: The new test only covers a single root-level $ref and does not exercise nested subschemas without $id; a test for that should be added.

judge.reason: Test coverage suggestion for nested subschemas, not a defect in the changed code.
